title: Fourteenth Northern Coastal Hydrology Symposium
key_sentences: The symposium brings together hydrologists, engineers and planners who work on estuaries, tidal rivers and low-lying coastal land.
This year the programme gives particular attention to compound flooding, where storm surge and river discharge arrive together.
Speakers are asked to load their slides in the preparation room at least one hour before their session.
Workshop W1 runs for three hours and has thirty places, which are allocated in order of registration.
Places at the symposium dinner must be booked with your registration and cannot be added on site.
